summary.what_it_is: An agent skill that converts four orthographic pixel art views (top, side, front, back) into a rotatable fake-3D sprite using voxel carving and slice rendering. It works with AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
summary.why_trending: New project (2 days old) that gained 477 stars in a single day, likely due to its AI-agent integration for turning 2D pixel art into interactive 3D-like sprites with a feature-rich viewer.
summary.who_its_for: Game developers, pixel artists, and AI-assisted coding users who want to create rotatable fake-3D assets from 2D pixel art.
